[LSCP.2.6.2] `internal` is not an author scope: it is absent from the
`<scope-value>` grammar ([LSCP.1.5]), so no author schema can declare it. The
built-in schemas that carry it are `ComputationError` and `TypeError`
([LERR.9.4]), which the built-in module declares ([LIMP.12.4]). They are registered schemas like any other, and an integration
enumerating schemas sees them with the lifecycle `internal` ([NDBG.2.2]). A
schema an integration feeds and rules may only read is `ambient`
([LSCP.2.5]).
